parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A javelin thrower noted the lengths of a random sample of 50 of her throws. The sample mean was 72.3 m and an unbiased estimate of the population variance was 64.3 $\text{m}^2$.

Find a 92% confidence interval for the population mean length of throws by this athlete.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A discus thrower wishes to calculate a 92% confidence interval for the population mean length of his throws. He bases his calculation on his first 50 throws in a week.

Comment on this method.
